theorems.statement: ∀ (n N m k : ℕ) (D Z : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (G : Rn n → Rn m) (w : Rn n → ℝ≥0∞), IsOpen D → ContinuousOn ψ D → InjOn ψ D → Continuous G → (∀ B ⊆ D, MeasurableSet B → B ⊆ Z → ∀ φ : Rn N → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ → AEMeasurable (fun y : Rn m ↦ ∫⁻ x in ψ '' (B ∩ G ⁻¹' {y}), φ x ∂μHE[k]) volume ∧ ∫⁻ u in B, φ (ψ u) * w u = ∫⁻ y, (∫⁻ x in ψ '' (B ∩ G ⁻¹' {y}), φ x ∂μHE[k]) ∂volume) → (∀ p ∈ D, p ∉ Z → ∃ O : Set (Rn n), IsOpen O ∧ p ∈ O ∧ ∀ B ⊆ D ∩ O, MeasurableSet B → ∀ φ : Rn N → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ → AEMeasurable (fun y : Rn m ↦ ∫⁻ x in ψ '' (B ∩ G ⁻¹' {y}), φ x ∂μHE[k]) volume ∧ ∫⁻ u in B, φ (ψ u) * w u = ∫⁻ y, (∫⁻ x in ψ '' (B ∩ G ⁻¹' {y}), φ x ∂μHE[k]) ∂volume) → ∀ B ⊆ D, MeasurableSet B → ∀ φ : Rn N → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ → AEMeasurable (fun y : Rn m ↦ ∫⁻ x in ψ '' (B ∩ G ⁻¹' {y}), φ x ∂μHE[k]) volume ∧ ∫⁻ u in B, φ (ψ u) * w u = ∫⁻ y, (∫⁻ x in ψ '' (B ∩ G ⁻¹' {y}), φ x ∂μHE[k]) ∂volume
